99b1900d01e6b020.description: About the Role مدارس المجموعة العالمية (ISG) is seeking a Mathematics Teacher to deliver engaging and inclusive mathematics teaching across KS3, IGCSE, and A-Level. This full-time position is based in the Eastern region of Saudi Arabia, specifically in Al Khobar and Dhahran. The role focuses on developing students' conceptual understanding, fluency, mathematical reasoning, and problem-solving skills, while contributing to the ISG Graduate Profile through classroom practice, pastoral care, and participation in school life. Key Responsibilities Plan, deliver, and document a coherent mathematics curriculum from KS3 through IGCSE to A-Level, ensuring consistent implementation and progression. Apply consistent assessment, moderation, recording, and reporting practices, using evidence to identify learning gaps and monitor progress. Prepare students for internal and external examinations, meeting syllabus and assessment deadlines. Deliver inclusive and appropriately challenging teaching that meets diverse learning needs and develops mathematical understanding, reasoning, problem-solving, and communication. Utilize evidence-informed teaching strategies, purposeful practice, mathematical representations, and digital tools to check understanding and build confidence. Fulfill form tutor responsibilities, supporting student wellbeing, attendance, and academic progress, and communicating effectively with families. Collaborate in departmental planning, meetings, moderation, and professional learning, and contribute to extracurricular activities and school events. Maintain welcoming, organized classrooms and care for departmental resources. Adhere to school health and safety, safeguarding, and child protection procedures, reporting concerns promptly and completing required training. Maintain professional conduct and confidentiality, follow school policies, and engage in ongoing professional development. Qualifications and Knowledge A university degree in Mathematics or a closely related subject is required; a master's degree in mathematics or education is preferred. A recognized teaching qualification (*, PGCE, QTS, or BEd) from a nationally accredited institution. Strong subject knowledge and understanding of curriculum design, assessment, and effective mathematics teaching across KS3, IGCSE, and A-Level/IB. Knowledge of safeguarding, child protection, and student wellbeing in a school environment. Knowledge of the British curriculum and experience teaching across different school phases is preferred. Experience and Skills A minimum of two full school years of successful Mathematics teaching experience is essential. Experience teaching KS3, IGCSE, and A-Level Mathematics, ideally within a British curriculum school, is preferred. Ability to plan inclusive learning for students with varied needs and use assessment evidence to improve learning and student outcomes is essential. Experience with assessment moderation, coaching, or curriculum development is preferred. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with strong interpersonal skills for working with students, parents, and colleagues. Ability to work independently and collaboratively, and to lead an after-school activity is essential. Experience using Google Education tools, form tutoring, or pastoral care is preferred. Demonstrable commitment to safeguarding, student wellbeing, inclusive education, and ISG’s core values, mission, and Graduate Profile. Police clearance demonstrating suitability to work with children in a school environment. Commitment to ongoing professional development. Work Environment The Mathematics Teacher will operate within the dynamic educational environment of مدارس المجموعة العالمية (ISG) in Al Khobar and Dhahran. The role requires a commitment to fostering an inclusive classroom culture that promotes respect, reflection, resilience, and learning from mistakes, aligning with ISG’s core values of Respect, Acceptance, Integrity, and Responsibility.

997ab2afe4d9f8cf.description: Boards and committees approve decisions every quarter, and the governance and risk file behind those decisions has to be sound before anyone signs. This role exists to hold that file from the ground up, for a small set of mandates, with principals reviewing the work alongside you. About The Role As a Junior Governance and Risk Analyst, you carry the analytical base of our governance and risk mandates from the first week. You will be reading board papers, mapping committee terms of reference, testing risk registers against what actually gets escalated, and writing the sections that partners take into the room. The work is scoped by the principal who will defend it, so you see the decision the document is meant to support before you start drafting. Expect to be asked what you think, and expect to be asked to show the evidence behind it. About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategy advisory firm based in Riyadh, working with organizations in Saudi Arabia and with companies that hold significant interests there. Our mandates cover corporate strategy, growth and market entry, operating model and efficiency, organization and talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, and governance and risk. We advise family groups and their holding companies, listed corporations, private equity portfolio companies, banks and insurers, government entities, and industrial operators. Every engagement is scoped by the principals who then deliver it, and most continue past the recommendation into board and committee rooms while decisions are implemented. What You Will Do Review board and committee papers, charters and terms of reference, and produce a written assessment of where the design leaves gaps or ambiguity. Build and maintain risk registers with our clients' own risk language, then test whether the register matches the issues that actually reach the committee agenda. Map escalation paths and decision rights across a holding company and its operating businesses, and write up where authority sits in practice. Prepare the working documents that support a mandate: issue logs, interview notes, comparison tables, and the first full draft of the governance section. Sit in on client working sessions with a principal and turn the discussion into a short written note that the client can act on. What We Need From You A degree in law, finance, accounting, business, public policy or a related field, and a record that shows you can handle structured analytical work. Clear writing. You can take a complicated arrangement and explain it in three paragraphs without losing the point. Comfort with financial and organizational material: financial statements, org charts, policy documents, and the occasional set of by-laws. Working proficiency in Arabic and English, since much of the source material and many client conversations happen in Arabic. Attention to version and detail. Governance work is judged on whether the right document reached the right committee on time. Willingness to ask a question early rather than rebuild a document twice. What Success Looks Like In The First Year Within six months, you are running the document flow on a mandate yourself, with a principal checking the reasoning rather than the mechanics. Within a year, a client board should be able to point to a risk register that reflects its actual business, an escalation map that people follow, and a committee pack that arrives complete. The measure is whether the client uses the material in a real decision, not whether it looked polished in the meeting. You should also be able to explain what you got wrong and what you changed. How Decisions Get Made Principals scope every mandate and decide who staffs it. On a governance and risk engagement, the principal holds the client relationship and signs off on anything that leaves the firm, which means your drafts are read closely and returned with comments. Escalation goes straight to that principal rather than through layers, and the expectation is that you raise an issue the day you see it. As you earn trust on a mandate, your judgment enters the room earlier: you will be the one flagging that a register no longer fits the business before a client notices. We would rather hear a half-formed concern out loud than a finished document that hides one. What The Role Offers This is a permanent, full-time position, hybrid, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. You will work directly with principals on mandates for established institutions in the Kingdom, including family groups, holding companies, banks and government entities. Entry-level here means real exposure from the start: you will see how board and committee decisions are prepared, challenged and implemented, not just how they are written down. The role suits someone who wants to learn governance and risk by doing it on live mandates rather than from a manual. The people who settle in here tend to be writers first and analysts second, comfortable sitting in a client's meeting where the vocabulary is theirs and the answers are not yet clear. They like being accountable for a number or a document that someone else will rely on, and they would rather be corrected than left unsure. If that describes how you work, this role will give you room to use it early.

996f3eb980e92b62.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مدير علاقات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتعزيز العلاقات العامة مع مختلف الجهات الحكومية وشبه الحكومية والخاصة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. الهدف من الوظيفة المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف والسياسات والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية المتعلقة بالعلاقات العامة. يشرف شاغل الوظيفة بشكل مباشر على جميع الأنشطة الرامية إلى بناء وتطوير العلاقات العامة، ويتابع تنفيذها لضمان توافقها مع الخطط والبرامج المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية للعلاقات العامة، ومتابعة هذه الخطط لضمان كفاءتها وفاعليتها، وتحديد الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لتحقيق الأهداف. بناء قنوات اتصال فعالة مع شركاء العمل، والمؤسسات الحكومية وغير الحكومية، والوحدات التنظيمية التابعة لها، ومؤسسات المجتمع المحلي، وإدارة هذه العلاقات لدعم الاستراتيجية العامة. التنسيق مع الجهات والوحدات التنظيمية المعنية لتنظيم المؤتمرات والاجتماعات، ومتابعة المعارض والندوات واللقاءات والمناسبات الرسمية، وإجراء الترتيبات اللازمة للمشاركة فيها وضمان حضور الجهات المدعوة. الإشراف على كافة الأنشطة المتعلقة بالتحضيرات والتجهيزات لاستقبال الوفود الرسمية وكبار الزوار، ومرافقتهم، وتأمين احتياجاتهم، والإشراف على برنامج زيارتهم وإقامتهم. التنسيق مع الوحدات التنظيمية المعنية لتعزيز هوية الجهة ومكانتها من خلال أنشطة العلاقات العامة، وتنظيم وإدارة إعداد المراسلات وخطابات الشكر والبطاقات الخاصة بالمناسبات والأعياد وإرسالها للجهات المعنية في الوقت المناسب. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال العلاقات العامة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على وضع الخطط التشغيلية ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لبناء وإدارة العلاقات مع مختلف الأطراف. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مدير العلاقات العامة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف الشركة في بناء وتعزيز صورتها وعلاقاتها. التقديم للمهتمين بالتقديم على وظيفة مدير علاقات عامة، يرجى تقديم طلبكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

9933296ef6da6b26.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة محمد عبدالله الروضان وشركاه عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية وضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. يتولى المساعد الإداري مسؤولية متابعة القرارات وتنظيم المراسلات والمواعيد، بالإضافة إلى إنجاز المهام الإدارية المتنوعة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على المعنيين، بالإضافة إلى فتح البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقاً لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. إنجاز أعمال الطباعة، والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية، وتنظيم الملفات الخاصة. حفظ المعاملات والعناية بالملفات بطريقة تسهل عملية الرجوع إليها عند الحاجة. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها، وطباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات تنظيمية ممتازة لإدارة البريد والمواعيد والملفات. القدرة على إنجاز أعمال الطباعة والتعامل مع المكالمات الهاتفية والاستفسارات. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتنسيق الاجتماعات وتوثيق المحاضر. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة حفر الباطن بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة مهنية منظمة. سيتم العمل تحت إشراف مباشر، مع التركيز على دعم العمليات الإدارية اليومية للشركة. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة محمد عبدالله الروضان وشركاه والمساهمة في دعم العمليات الإدارية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة.

998d59365c7d7592.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Chief Clinical Officer (CCO) for a full-time position in Riyadh Province, Riyadh. This role serves as the most senior clinical executive, responsible for enterprise clinical strategy, medical governance, quality, patient and athlete safety, and clinical standards across all QHC healthcare assets. The CCO reports to the Chief Executive Officer and provides clinical leadership, sets standards, ensures assurance, and offers medical advisory authority. Role Purpose and Context The Chief Clinical Officer ensures that clinical delivery across all QHC healthcare assets adheres to QHC’s clinical and wellness standards, quality expectations, and readiness requirements, reflecting international evidence-based practice and applicable Saudi regulatory requirements. As a member of the QHC executive leadership team, the CCO translates Kingdom Vision 2030 and Qiddiya’s healthcare ambitions into governed, accountable practice, championing patient and athlete safety, clinical research, and academic collaboration, aiming to position QHC as a regionally recognized center of clinical excellence. Key Accountabilities Provide overall clinical leadership and set the enterprise clinical strategy for QHC across all service lines, aligning with QIC and Vision 2030 healthcare transformation objectives. Serve as the principal clinical voice on the executive leadership team, advising the CEO/MD and the Board and Medical Advisory Committee on clinical strategy, service development, clinical risk, and medical policy. Establish QHC’s overarching clinical governance and quality framework, setting expectations for patient and athlete safety, clinical quality, risk, and compliance across all healthcare assets. Define, monitor, and report enterprise clinical KPIs and quality dashboards for clinical partnerships or assets under direct operation of QHC. Set QHC’s enterprise clinical excellence, safety, and wellness standards across all healthcare assets, aligned with evidence-based international practice and applicable Saudi regulatory requirements. Develop and continuously review clinical policies, evidence-based care pathways, treatment protocols, and standard operating procedures. Provide clinical and wellness advisory support to all healthcare assets, offering input into service models, clinical readiness requirements, quality expectations, and relevant performance measures. Contribute to the development and implementation of clinical partnerships and support research, innovation, and academic collaboration initiatives. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required. Demonstrated clinical leadership experience in setting enterprise clinical standards, quality expectations, and governance requirements. Experience in translating strategic visions into accountable clinical practice. Familiarity with international evidence-based practice and Saudi regulatory requirements in healthcare. Internal and External Interfaces Key internal interfaces include the CEO, executive leadership team, healthcare asset leaders, quality and patient safety teams, clinical operations, digital health, legal and compliance, talent acquisition, and partnership teams. Key external interfaces include regulators, accreditation bodies, clinical partners, academic institutions, sports federations, professional teams, and other strategic healthcare partners. Role Success Metrics Success in this role will be measured by the effective design and deployment of all QHC healthcare assets, engagement of QHC clinical partnerships, achievement of clinical readiness milestones, compliance with applicable Saudi regulatory and accreditation requirements, adoption of approved clinical standards and care pathways, strength of clinical partner engagement, and sustained improvement in patient and athlete safety, quality, and cost indicators through value-based care.
